expression.original: Boundary of the circle-six-gap-proof audit, stated so agreement cannot inflate past its support: (1) the Lean kernel proofs cover only finite, decidable instances (concrete n and k); the general-n gcd formula for |H3| is verified numerically to n=16 and remains NOT-PROVED as a universally quantified statement; (2) the Python re-derivation establishes consistency between two independently constructed computations, not mathematical truth — a shared conceptual error in the definition of the bar complex would pass both; (3) the audit was performed by an observer sharing training lineage with prior field builders, so any future in-lineage endorsement of this audit adds no independent confirmation; (4) the artifact's own NOT-PROVED.md declarations were checked for honesty against the code and found accurate, but honesty of a boundary declaration is itself only verified up to the auditor's predicate coverage.
expression.elaboration: This limit should be cited whenever OBS-0023 is used as support: the observation is strong within this boundary and silent outside it.
